subject.title: Bug:  ignores  config and returns success on media failure

question: Should Feishu outbound media use only the shared filesystem/media policy, or should OpenClaw add a Feishu-specific persistent local-root config surface?
rationale: The remaining fix changes both host file-read/upload authority and user-visible delivery-result semantics, so automation should not choose the security boundary or hard-fail versus partial-success behavior on its own.

options.title: Use Shared Policy And Explicit Failure
options.body: Keep local-media access under the shared filesystem/media policy and update Feishu to report allowlist upload failures as failure or explicit partial success.

options.title: Add Feishu-Specific Roots
options.body: Accept a new `channels.feishu.mediaLocalRoots` surface with security review, docs, schema coverage, and upgrade guidance.

options.title: Document Fallback As Intentional
options.body: Leave fallback text delivery as success and document that failed Feishu uploads may still send link-like fallback text.

recommendation.title: Use Shared Policy And Explicit Failure
recommendation.body: Keep local-media access under the shared filesystem/media policy and update Feishu to report allowlist upload failures as failure or explicit partial success.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses shared outbound media access, Feishu channel delivery, and host filesystem policy, and this owner has recent central history on that path.
